items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: anecdote about the three hour orchestral session with Bjork

ctx.x: Because I saw that anecdote about the three hour orchestral session with Bjork that she showed up at the last ten minutes or something and I can imagine that was a pretty tense situation with all those people sitting there and the clock running.

It was but the amazing thing, obviously, because it’s you know her singing live with a big band, first take. It’s got that excitement of a first take with a big band. And there’s no way — well there’s no way we could have done it as a backing track with her singing on top of it, but also six takes and the whole level of excitement would have gone right © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
